Container.Name: openrcs
Container.Overview: Google Messages (SMS/RCS) for AI agents over MCP, on your tailnet through the server's own Tailscale (the Tailscale plugin). Before the first start, run once in a terminal: docker network create openrcs. The app is published on 127.0.0.1:5480 only; after it starts, run: tailscale serve --bg --https=5443 http://127.0.0.1:5480, and set OPENRCS_URL to the address that prints. Guide: docs/self-hosting.md in the project.
Container.Requires: The Tailscale plugin with MagicDNS and HTTPS certificates enabled on your tailnet, and a Docker network named openrcs (docker network create openrcs).

Config.Name: OPENRCS_URL
Config.Description: The Tailscale Serve address, e.g. https://tower.your-tailnet.ts.net:5443 (no trailing slash). Also the OAuth issuer: changing it signs agents out.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and generated secrets. Back up this folder as a whole.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app and its data files run as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app and its data files run as.

Config.Name: KEY_PEPPER
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to generate one into the data folder on first start. base64 of 32 bytes.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to generate one into the data folder on first start.
